unit: H51 — charging issued blood to the bill

Issuing a blood request charges the bags.ar: صرف طلب الدم يحسب الأكياس على فاتورة المريض بهذه الخدمة؛ والمنتج الذي لم تُربط له خدمة يُصرف دون حساب
Issuing a blood request charges the bags.en: Issuing a blood request charges the bags to the patient's bill as this service; a product with none is issued uncharged
